ops-bot: Rollout created: roll/dxb-dedicated-v1. Canary order: dxb-zone-a -> dxb-zone-b. Alerts: #dedicated-ops #sales #support.

tariq: Any changes to reservation or billing for customers in the region?

isabel: Reserved contracts unaffected. New pools available for regional Dedicated reservations and burst allocations. Intro pricing: same base rate as EU West for parity; burst multiplier 1.2x for on-demand bursts. Billing preview added to Console under Dedicated -> Regions -> Dubai.

sophia: Need runbook and support templates for latency-sensitive customers and region-specific compliance checks.

isabel: Runbook and compliance checklist uploaded: <internal://playbooks/dxb-dedicated-oncall>. Included steps for KMS integration and audit log verification.

ops-bot: Canary: dxb-zone-a completed. No regressions. Canary: dxb-zone-b scheduled 2026-09-01T03:00Z. Full roll expected within 24h if metrics stable.

sales-bot: Sales kit updated with FAQ and regional pricing examples. Auto-email to existing MENA trial users scheduled for rollout start.
